subject: Learning Methods
title: Generation Effect in Learning
description: One-minute skill: Generation Effect in Learning.

hook.text: Completing a word like 'mem___' for memory produces better recall than reading the full word 'memory.'

buildup.text: Generation Effect in Learning sets up the method, the mechanism, and the learning tradeoff.

discovery.text: Generating an answer requires deeper processing and retrieval. Even partial generation strengthens the memory trace.

twist.text: This is why fill-in-the-blank tests are more effective for learning than multiple choice. Generation trumps recognition.

climax.text: Create your own study materials: write questions, generate summaries, fill in blanks.

punchline.text: Generate the answer, don't just recognize it.

quiz.question: Why does generating information produce better recall?
options: It takes more time, so you spend longer on the material
Active generation requires deeper processing and retrieval effort
Writing by hand improves motor memory
